prompt: Give the panel a BorderLayout and add the provided header label, body text area, and footer label to the NORTH, CENTER, and SOUTH regions.
explanation: BorderLayout divides a container into five regions; NORTH and SOUTH keep their preferred height while CENTER stretches to fill the rest, which is why the growable text area belongs there. You choose the region with the two-argument add(component, constraint) call. A JPanel defaults to FlowLayout, so setLayout(new BorderLayout()) must happen before (or as) the components are added with constraints.
hints: Call setLayout(new BorderLayout()) first -- a JPanel starts with a FlowLayout.
The two-argument add takes the component and a region constant, e.g. add(header, BorderLayout.NORTH).
The stretchy middle region is BorderLayout.CENTER -- that is where the text area goes.
